# Recommendation

We oppose the proposed rule for the following reasons:

- The rule assumes that retail investors read proxy statements.
- But the Commission's own survey shows that fewer than 10 percent do.
- Therefore the added disclosure will not reach the investors it is meant to protect.
- This means the costs fall on issuers while the benefits never materialize.
- As a result, the rule fails the cost-benefit analysis that Section 2(b) requires.
